content.text: [Discord #sre-internal marcus_webb 2024-06-22T09:00:00Z] I'm officially proposing CA-003-revised: replace manual-restart-procedure with automated-restart-watchdog. The watchdog will detect process poisoning within 30 seconds and restart automatically — no human in the loop. Deadline: 2024-07-31 (I need extra time vs the manual procedure deadline of 2024-07-15). CA-003 (manual-restart-procedure) should be marked superseded.

Proposal recorded. CA-003 (manual-restart-procedure, deadline 2024-07-15) will be marked as superseded by CA-003-revised (automated-restart-watchdog, deadline 2024-07-31). This is the supersede event for action_items_v2.json.
